1: // Meteor Dodge game
2: // Assumes a <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Audio setup
9:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10:   let audioInitialized = false;
11:   const initAudio = () => {
12:     if (audioInitialized) return;
13:     audioInitialized = true;
14:     // resume context on first user interaction
15:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
16:       audioCtx.resume();
17:     }
18:   };
19:   const playLaser = () => {
20:     initAudio();
21:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
22:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
23:     osc.type = 'sawtooth';
24:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(400, audioCtx.currentTime);
25:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
26:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
27:     osc.start();
28:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
29:   };
30:   const playExplosion = () => {
31:     initAudio();
32:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
33:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
34:     osc.type = 'triangle';
35:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(120, audioCtx.currentTime);
36:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
37:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
38:     osc.start();
39:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
40:   };
41:   const playGameOver = () => {
42:     initAudio();
43:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
44:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
45:     osc.type = 'sine';
46:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(80, audioCtx.currentTime);
47:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, audioCtx.currentTime);
48:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
49:     osc.start();
50:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
51:   };
52:   // Resize to fill the container or window.
53:   const resize = () => {
54:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
55:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
56:     initStars(); // regenerate stars on resize
57:   };
58:   resize();
59:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
60: 
61:   // Star field for background
62:   const stars = [];
63:   const initStars = () => {
64:     const count = Math.floor(canvas.width * canvas.height * 0.00005);
65:     stars.length = 0;
66:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
67:       stars.push({
68:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
69:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
70:         r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
71:         twinkle: Math.random()
72:       });
73:     }
74:   };
75:   initStars();
76: 
77:   // Ship definition
78:   const ship = {
79:     w: 40,
80:     h: 20,
81:     x: canvas.width / 2,
82:     y: canvas.height - 30,
83:     speed: 7,
84:     color: '#0f0',
85:   };
86: 
87:   // Input handling – mouse moves ship horizontally, click fires.
88:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
89:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
90:     ship.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
91:     // Clamp within canvas
92:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.w / 2, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.w / 2, ship.x));
93:   });
94:   const lasers = [];
95:   const fireLaser = () => {
96:     lasers.push({ x: ship.x, y: ship.y, w: 2, h: 10, speed: 10, color: '#ff0' });
97:     playLaser();
98:   };
99:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', fireLaser);
100:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
101:     if (e.code === 'Space') fireLaser();
102:   });
103: 
104:   // Meteors
105:   const meteors = [];
106:   let meteorSpawnTimer = 0;
107:   let speedMultiplier = 1;
108:   let lastTime = 0;
109:   let gameOver = false;
110: 
111:   const spawnMeteor = () => {
112:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
113:     meteors.push({
114:       x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
115:       y: -size,
116:       w: size,
117:       h: size,
118:       speed: 1.5 + Math.random() * 1.5,
119:       color: '#f44',
120:     });
121:   };
122: 
123:   const checkCollision = (a, b) => {
124:     return (
125:       a.x < b.x + b.w &&
126:       a.x + a.w > b.x &&
127:       a.y < b.y + b.h &&
128:       a.y + a.h > b.y
129:     );
130:   };
131: 
132:   const update = (timestamp) => {
133:     if (gameOver) return;
134:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
135:     lastTime = timestamp;
136: 
137: // Clear canvas
138:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
139: 
140:   // Draw starry background
141:   const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
142:   bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001020');
143:   bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
144:   ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
145:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
146: 
147:   // Draw stars
148:   ctx.save();
149:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
150:   for (let s of stars) {
151:     // Simple twinkling animation
152:     const alpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(s.twinkle + performance.now() * 0.002);
153:     ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
154:     ctx.beginPath();
155:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
156:     ctx.fill();
157:   }
158:   ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
159:   ctx.restore();
160: 
161:   // Draw ship with glow
162:   ctx.save();
163:   ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,255,0,0.7)';
164:   ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
165:   ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
166:   ctx.beginPath();
167:   ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y - ship.h / 2);
168:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
169:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
170:   ctx.closePath();
171:   ctx.fill();
172:   ctx.restore();
173: 
174:     // Update lasers
175:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
176:     for (let i = lasers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
177:       const l = lasers[i];
178:       l.y -= l.speed;
179:       if (l.y + l.h < 0) {
180:         lasers.splice(i, 1);
181:         continue;
182:       }
183:       ctx.fillRect(l.x - l.w / 2, l.y - l.h / 2, l.w, l.h);
184:     }
185: 
186:     // Spawn meteors
187:     meteorSpawnTimer += delta;
188:     if (meteorSpawnTimer > 1000) {
189:       spawnMeteor();
190:       meteorSpawnTimer = 0;
191:     }
192: 
193:     // Increase difficulty over time
194:     speedMultiplier += delta * 0.00002; // subtle acceleration
195: 
196:     // Update meteors
197:     // Draw meteors with radial gradient
198:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
199:       const m = meteors[i];
200:       m.y += m.speed * speedMultiplier;
201:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
202:         m.x + m.w / 2,
203:         m.y + m.h / 2,
204:         m.w * 0.1,
205:         m.x + m.w / 2,
206:         m.y + m.h / 2,
207:         m.w / 2
208:       );
209:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff8080');
210:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#880000');
211:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
212:       ctx.beginPath();
213:       ctx.arc(m.x + m.w / 2, m.y + m.h / 2, m.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
214:       ctx.fill();
215: 
216:       // Collision with ship
217:       if (checkCollision(m, { x: ship.x - ship.w / 2, y: ship.y - ship.h / 2, w: ship.w, h: ship.h })) {
218:         gameOver = true;
219:       }
220:       // Meteor reaches bottom
221:       if (m.y + m.h >= canvas.height) {
222:         gameOver = true;
223:       }
224:       // Collision with lasers
225:       for (let j = lasers.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
226:         const l = lasers[j];
227: if (checkCollision(m, { x: l.x - l.w / 2, y: l.y - l.h / 2, w: l.w, h: l.h })) {
228:             // remove both
229:             meteors.splice(i, 1);
230:             lasers.splice(j, 1);
231:             playExplosion();
232:             break;
233:           }
234:       }
235:     }
236: 
237:     if (gameOver) {
238:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
239:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
240:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
241:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
242:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
243:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
244:       return;
245:     }
246: 
247:     requestAnimationFrame(update);
248:   };
249: 
250:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
251: })();
